entities.summary: Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh, also referred to as Khürelsükh Ukhnaa, is a Mongolian politician who has been the president of Mongolia since 2021. He previously served as the 30th prime minister from 2017 to 2021 and was elected to the Parliament of Mongolia four times – in 2000, 2004, 2012 and 2020.
